description: Declared deploy bundle for PR #230 disk-lifecycle scripts and LaunchAgents: disk_space_alert.py, kanban_workspace_sweep.py, and the three com.colingreig.hermes.* sweep/alert plists. These files previously had no manifest, so mini-release-cut.sh could merge them to main while the live mini kept stale/missing copies (same defect class as 86e2hap1g / v0.18.2). This file IS the bundle install_disk_lifecycle.py copies; nothing outside its files list is written.

coexist_required.reason: disk_space_alert.py imports slack_msg_builder for Slack delivery; owned by other bundles (e.g. hermes_usage_alert / pr_pipeline), never installed by this bundle

files.role: trailing Slack alarm when mini free space drops below threshold; fail-closed on disk-free check errors
age-based backstop for terminal kanban scratch workspaces across all boards
launchd schedule for worktree_backstop_sweep.py (script deployed separately from scripts/)
